name: msmarco_mini
description: Offline MSMARCO-style passage ranking fixture (not the full dataset).

documents.text: Compute-in-memory performs matrix-vector multiplication inside memory arrays to reduce data movement for neural inference.
NOR flash floating-gate transistors store charge that sets conductance; repeated reads can disturb trapped charge and shift thresholds.
BM25 is a sparse ranking function using term frequency and inverse document frequency with document length normalization.
Retrieval-augmented generation retrieves passages and conditions a language model on them to answer questions with external knowledge.
Low-density parity-check codes over GF(3) enable soft-decision decoding with per-symbol LLR vectors for non-binary alphabets.
nDCG measures ranking quality by discounting graded relevance with a logarithmic position discount and normalizing by the ideal ranking.
SRAM compute-in-memory offers low noise but limited density compared with flash-based CiM for large on-device knowledge bases.
Edge devices keep private documents local; uploading fab recipes or medical notes to the cloud violates local-first privacy constraints.
Contriever and BGE are dense retrievers that embed queries and passages into a shared vector space for cosine similarity search.
Analog MAC residuals and ADC quantization inject errors into stored embeddings when vectors live in CiM crossbars.
Hybrid retrieval combines BM25 candidate generation with dense reranking to cut latency on resource-limited edge SoCs.
Natural Questions is an open-domain QA benchmark with real Google queries and Wikipedia answer spans.
